MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.1 and BlazeFace Short Range model (float16, version 1)
Copyright Google LLC and MediaPipe contributors.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

The package JS/WASM files are unmodified copies from @mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.1.1.
Source distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-1.1.1.tgz
Source project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Model URL and file SHA-256 values are recorded in manifest.json.
The official model card, including its Apache-2.0 license statement and limitations,
is included as model-card.pdf. This short-range detector can miss small, occluded,
profile or blurred faces. No identity recognition is performed.

Filemoa loads these assets from its own origin for local inference. It does not
upload input images, face/eye coordinates or measurements through this module.
The model authors do not endorse or guarantee Filemoa's quality judgements.

Face Landmarker float16 version 1 bundle (FaceMesh V2):
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
Official FaceMesh V2 and Blendshape V2 model cards document Apache-2.0 licensing
and are included as landmark-model-card.pdf and blendshape-model-card.pdf.
Only eyelid contours are used. Expression scores and transformation matrices are
disabled. Face identity recognition and landmark uploads are not performed.
